description: Searches OpenAny's current catalog of data APIs and AI models by keyword. Get live catalog counts from openany_overview. Use when the user wants keyword or SEO research (Google, Bing, SERP, search volume, keyword difficulty, DataForSEO), social posts or accounts on Xiaohongshu (小红书, RedNote), Douyin (抖音, TikTok China), Weibo (微博), TikTok, X (Twitter), Instagram or YouTube, cryptocurrency prices or on-chain data (CoinGecko, DefiLlama, DexScreener, Polymarket), lead or company data (Hunter email finder, Qichacha/企查查, Crustdata), finance or legal research, or to generate chat, image, video or audio with models such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Midjourney, Veo or Kling. After a match, call get_api to inspect schema and price; call run_api only after the user confirms the live price. Discovery and price checks are free; execution needs an OpenAny API key. Eligible Agent newcomers automatically receive $0.10 in credit.
